device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Full HD combo receiver with CI slot, smartcard reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.soc: ALi M3503 (M3516 class dual-CPU DVB-S2 SoC, chip word 0x35030001; SND_S3503 in the SEE program, Libcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126)
device.family: M3503 (chips/m3503.py), matched by the bootloader chunk's version "39015-01047"
device.demod: internal DVB-S2 (NIM_S3503) + external DVB-T2/C combo demodulator
device.tuner: unknown (maincode is encrypted by the board's security IC)

source.author: Ferguson
source.note: Archive A153Combo_20150320_V1.28B3.zip from the Ferguson Ariva 153combo Ariva253combo directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-09.

simulator.note: The bootloader runs as M3503 revision B (run_dump_a153_combo_security_ic.py): it executes from the flash window with cache-as-RAM stack at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, jumps into its RAM copy at 0x80C985C4, writes " On " to its FD650K front panel on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA), unpacks the LZO1X-compressed SEE program (0x1599CA -> 0x2D6B5C bytes at 0x81202000 via lzo1x_decompress_safe at 0x80C86348), and starts the parked SEE at 0xA0C938F8 to copy it to 0xA6000200 (entry 0x86001000) and park again.  It then sends the first 1 KB of the main code (0x030080) in 64 blocks of 16 bytes over bit-banged I2C on GPIO 7 (SCL) / 8 (SDA) to the board's security IC at 0x62 (command 0xA2, 7 fixed bytes 42 29 14 e6 fa 9f 15, 16 encrypted bytes, CRC-16/BUYPASS).  Without the chip's plaintext, LzmaDecode() at 0x80C9B780 yields 0 bytes and the bootloader jumps to an empty 0x80000200.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 153 Combo official firmware V1.28B3 (2015-03-20) for the Full HD DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the dual-CPU ALi M3503 (M3516) platform (sharing the "HSJU" board family with the Opticum AX 502 Combo).

Chunk chain: bootloader 0x000000 ("HSJU", version 39015-01047, 2013-11-06), MemCfg 0x02F000, maincode 0x030000 ("V1.28B3*", 4.03 MB, first 1 KB encrypted for the board's security IC), seecode 0x450000 ("V1.28B3", 1.35 MB LZO1X-compressed -> 2.84 MB, SND_S3503 / DECV_S3601 / DECA_S3601, Libcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126), radioback 0x600000, seeback 0x61FF80, ARIVA153COMBO 0x630000 (boot logo), data 0x64FF80, defaultdb 0x6A0000, userdb 0x6FFF80.

Front panel: FD650K ("PAN_FD650K" / "PAN_CH455_0" in the bootloader) on GPIO bank 4 (0xB8000454) bits 7 / 6 -- SCL = GPIO 135, SDA = GPIO 134 -- displaying " On " during boot; the security IC sits at I2C 0x62 on GPIO bank 0 (0xB8000054) bits 7 / 8 -- SCL = GPIO 7, SDA = GPIO 8.
